draft_en.subject: Industrial PoE below EtherWAN - DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 13 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial PoE positions below EtherWAN in your shop: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, neutral packing - model STI-288GP - $60 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the L2 managed version, Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $78.9.

One question: which industrial PoE port count do your customers order most - 4, 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
